verdict.rationale: The evidence supports modular component organization: single-file components separate HTML, JS and styles per component [vue-comm-8], and the ecosystem scales incrementally [vue-docs-2]. Nothing in the pack documents a dependency-injection mechanism. One community comment says that wiring state through a global Vuex store breaks component modularity [vue-comm-19], which further weakens the 'injected building blocks' part of the story. Missing for 10: any first-party documentation of a dependency-injection API, evidence of injecting services or dependencies into components, and independent or hands-on corroboration of DI-based modular architecture.
